scope: Sargent and Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1 (Finite States), Chapter 9: Abstract Dynamic Programming. Order stability (upward, downward) of self-maps of partially ordered sets, its relation to global stability and order duality; abstract dynamic programs (V, {T_sigma}) with greedy policies, the Bellman operator, the Howard operator and HPI; finite, order stable and max-stable ADPs with Lemma B.4.1, Propositions 9.2.1 and 9.2.5 and Theorem 9.2.4 (max-optimality); ADPs generated by RDPs, MDPs, Q-factors and risk-sensitive Q-factors; Proposition 9.2.3 (well-posed iff order stable on order intervals); the proofs of Theorems 8.1.1 and 8.1.2 through ADPs with the OPI Lemmas 9.2.6-9.2.10; mixed strategies; min-optimality by order duality (Theorem 9.2.11); with the provable exercises.
source: Thomas J. Sargent and John Stachurski, Dynamic Programming, Volume 1: Finite States, Chapter 9, pp. 292-307, and Appendix B.4, pp. 349-351.
